dockerfile_review.source:
# Stage 1: Build
FROM node:22-alpine AS build

WORKDIR /app

COPY package*.json ./

RUN npm install --legacy-peer-deps

COPY . .

RUN npm run build


# Stage 2: Production
FROM nginx:alpine

COPY --from=build /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html

EXPOSE 80

CMD ["nginx", "-g", >"daemon off;"]
